image_description: A flock of Australian Pelicans standing on reddish-orange sand or dirt. The central subject is a large pelican in profile, displaying white plumage with black wing feathers and a prominent pinkish bill/pouch. Several other pelicans are visible in the background and foreground, some sitting and some standing. In the far background, there are trees and white buildings.
